title: How to pick your first tech track
excerpt: A simple way to choose between web, data and design.
body: List three things you enjoy doing, then match them to a track. Try a small task in each for a week, and keep the one that you keep returning to.

title: Build a portfolio with small tasks
excerpt: Why many small projects beat one big unfinished one.
body: Finish tasks end to end, write a short note about what you learned, and publish each one. Recruiters prefer visible, completed work.

title: Interview preparation in one week
excerpt: A day-by-day plan you can follow.
body: Day 1-2: review your projects. Day 3-4: practise answers aloud. Day 5: mock interview. Day 6: fix weak spots. Day 7: rest.

title: Python automation ideas for beginners
excerpt: Five tiny scripts that save real time.
body: Rename files in bulk, merge spreadsheets, send reminder emails, resize images and scrape a page you read daily.

title: Writing a one-page resume
excerpt: Keep it short, specific and honest.
body: Lead with skills and projects, add measurable results, and remove anything that doesn’t support the role you are applying for.

title: What to expect in a virtual internship
body: You receive tasks, submit work, get feedback and improve. Clear communication matters as much as the code you write.
